title: p2025 source document
description: A document an edge is cited from. The registry deliberately describes the DOCUMENT, not the role: one page can be the citation for many people.

kind.description: primary = the volume or an official record; reputable_reporting = named reporting used only where no primary record is reachable.

locator.description: Where in the document the claim is printed, e.g. 'p. 27'.

retrieved_at.description: The date this record's author last read the document.
